common_event_history_pullback.continuous_history_gate: Bernstein bounds cover every theta cell continuously, split at all translated time-grid breakpoints; sampled histories are forbidden
common_event_history_pullback.orders_three_and_four_rule: obtain Y_k by the factorial Faà-di-Bruno composition of the flow jet z(t,J) with the event jet T(delta), cellwise in theta

forbidden_substitutes: pointwise orbit speed without a pulse-history tube
Floquet eigenvalue without a validated RFDE Riesz splitting

highest_order_remainder_tube.acceptance_gate: on every exact time cell, a directed fixed-point radius r has strictly positive closure gap r-r_endpoint; translated remainder sources use already closed cells
highest_order_remainder_tube.residual_source: substitute the degree-four parameter polynomial into the cubic RFDE; bound every parameter coefficient of degree at least five plus all time-Taylor truncation residuals by directed Bernstein arithmetic

implicit_event_jet.event_remainder_gate: directed substitution of T(delta) into g gives an order-five residual; interval Newton in time and the uniform speed lower bound enclose R_tau5 and prove one event for every delta
implicit_event_jet.orders_three_and_four_rule: for k=3,4, expand the factorial Taylor coefficient of g(T(delta),J0+delta); isolate its unique linear term g_t*tau_k and set tau_k=-(all remaining order-k terms)/g_t

jet_equations.breakpoint_rule: the pulse release t=1 and both delay translates by 4*sqrt(5) and 5*sqrt(5) are exact cell boundaries for every coefficient
jet_equations.initial_history: z_0 is the exact J-independent quiet history; z_k=0 on the initial history for k=1,...,4
jet_equations.multilinear_derivatives: B_m(t)[q_1,...,q_m]=D^m F evaluated along z_0, with current and each delayed slot retained separately; B_m=0 for m>=4

stable_gap_and_interval_newton.acceptance_gate: all histories lie in the validated stable-graph chart; 0 notin H'(I); the directed interval Newton image N(I) is a strict subset of int(I); endpoint H intervals have the declared opposite signs
stable_gap_and_interval_newton.conclusion_if_all_gates_close: one and only one J_c in I satisfies H(J_c)=0; this is a local stable-sheet intersection, not two-sided basin routing
stable_gap_and_interval_newton.splitting: write the event history in validated coordinates y=(y_s,y_u) from the RFDE Riesz splitting
stable_gap_and_interval_newton.stable_gap_derivative: H'(J)=f_u*D_J y_u-Dh_s(y_s)*D_J y_s, including event-time terms already present in the common-event history jet

contract.theorem_statement: This artifact fixes the equations and acceptance gates for an event-aligned fourth-order parameter-jet proof. It supplies no strict numerical constant, hence validates no jet tube, pulse event, complete-history family, stable-sheet intersection, physical onset, or two-sided routing.

manifest.arithmetic_scope: source-bound Stage-5 proof schema for factorial-normalized parameter derivative jets z0,...,z4, a directed order-five remainder tube, an implicit Route-C event jet, a common-event complete-history pullback, the RFDE stable-coordinate gap, and an interval-Newton uniqueness gate; no strict numerical input is supplied by this contract
